fields.Found at: The harbor chain, dawn to dusk

blocks.text: Runs the quays of [[Port Vellen]] with a tide-table memory and a voice like a foghorn. Nothing is loaded or unloaded without Hobb's chalk mark. He is the first person any newcomer to Vellen actually meets.

traits.name: Tide-Table Memory
traits.text: Hobb can recall every vessel, cargo and captain that has passed the chain in the last ten years.

actions.name: Boathook
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bellow
actions.text: Every creature within 30 ft. that can hear Hobb must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or be distracted until the end of its next turn.

blocks.text: Hobb takes a quiet retainer from [[Kestrel Vane]] to chalk certain crates without looking inside. He tells himself it's harbor-peace money. If pressed with proof, he'll cooperate — ashamed, not defiant.
